### Added
- **The serving slice: `components.kserve-runtime-configs`, the models Gateway with one Dex JWT policy, `examples/serving-slice.yaml`, two 24 GB presets** (giantswarm/agent-platform#326; bumblebee-plans#46, the plan's D4/D6/D8/D9; epic giantswarm/giantswarm#37639). `components.kserve-runtime-configs` (giantswarm/kserve, `0.2.x`, `dependsOn: [kserve-llmisvc-crd]`, into the release namespace — where the llm-d controller resolves well-known configs from, besides the LLMInferenceService's own) installs the well-known `LLMInferenceServiceConfig`s with `kserve.llmisvcConfigs.enabled: true`, `kserve.servingruntime.enabled: false` and no registry value (the chart's gsoci default, giantswarm/kserve#78); its block is held back from connectivity. `modelServing.modelsGateway` (off by default — the Gateway is the slice's) renders one agentgateway `Gateway` `models` on `models.<global.domain>` with the platform's wildcard (or a `Certificate` from `tls.issuerRef`), the external-dns hostname, and one `AgentgatewayPolicy` (`Strict`, `inheritance: Override`, audience `dex-k8s-authenticator`, JWKS from the issuer's host on 443); KServe's `kserve.controller.gateway.ingressGateway.kserveGateway` is derived onto the `kserve-resources` release so every `LLMInferenceService` route attaches to it, and the discovery ConfigMap names the endpoint and the `/<namespace>/<model>/v1` convention. `examples/serving-slice.yaml` is the one-release-per-target-cluster profile: the five kserve components and the switch, `runtimeClassName: nvidia`, agentgateway off beside the platform's release and on for a workload cluster (nothing is detected). Presets `qwen3-4b-instruct` and `qwen3-8b-fp8` (one L4-class GPU, tools on, no image; the schema gains `spec.template`). The default render is byte-identical but for the roster entry. `make verify-serving-slice`; README "The serving slice and the models Gateway"; docs/authentication.md section 6.
